meta.name: terraform-module-library
meta.description: Build reusable Terraform modules for AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI infrastructure following infrastructure-as-code best practices. Use when creating infrastructure modules, standardizing cloud provisioning, or implementing reusable IaC components.

copy.tagline: 用代码构建跨云可复用的基础设施模块
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在为多云环境编写可复用的Terraform模块。
copy.tagline_en: Build reusable infrastructure modules across clouds with code.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're writing reusable Terraform modules for multi-cloud infrastructure.

howto.what: Claude 会按标准目录结构生成可复用的 Terraform 模块:main.tf、variables.tf,并附 examples 示例与 Terratest 测试,覆盖 AWS、Azure、GCP、OCI。
howto.when: 当你要创建基础设施模块、统一云资源供给方式,或落地 IaC 可复用组件时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 AWS VPC 的 Terraform 模块。
给这个模块补上变量校验和 Terratest 测试。
say.note: 补上输入校验与 Go 测试文件

say.text: 用 vpc 模块的输出组合出一个 RDS 模块。
say.note: 演示模块间输出与引用的组合

howto.what_en: Claude generates reusable Terraform modules in a standard layout—main.tf, variables.tf, outputs.tf, examples, and Terratest tests—for AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you create infrastructure modules, standardize cloud provisioning, or build reusable IaC components.

say_en.text: Write an AWS VPC Terraform module.
Add variable validation and Terratest tests to this module.
say_en.note: Adds input validation and a Go test file.

say_en.text: Compose an RDS module using the VPC module outputs.
say_en.note: Shows wiring outputs into another module.
